item.description:
What's New

  • Resolved an issue where subscription status did not always trigger UI elements correctly.
  • Removed noise hallucinations for better transcripts.
  • Added an alert and a sound for when the app cannot hear you.
  • New sound alerts for recording start and stop.
  • No longer show an active visualizer during paused recordings.

Bug Fixes

  • Fixed a crash when navigating back to the list view after immediately playing a note.
  • Resolved an issue with downloading merged audio files.

What's New

  • We now notify you if Cleft hasn't heard your voice in over 5 seconds
  • If you’ve loaded your notes and then lose internet you can still edit the transcript or note and sync it online later
  • The language dropdown now has an option for Auto-Detect. Helpful for multi-lingual users!

Bug Fixes

  • Fixed an issue where deleting a new note right after recording it could create an offline version of it
  • Fixed a problem that could occur when you delete all notes inside of a tag filter
  • Fixed a crash caused by recording multiple notes back to back to back
  • Resolved an issue where notes were failing to load and launch properly

What's New

  • Start a new note with just text. Paste transcripts in from other tools or just type.
  • You can now quickly regenerate the AI notes on demand from the 3 dot menu. Useful for getting a fresh set of notes after a merge!
  • New notes list design
  • The notes list will refresh automatically when you open from it's closed state
  • Tags now display on the notes list
  • Tags can now have spaces, capital letters, and are sorted alphabetically

Bug Fixes

  • Photos inserted into documents will now resize to fit the view.
  • Fixed the Editor resetting if you toggled the sidebar
